Nina: quick user report - function-calling guide still shows `response_schema` and old SDK calls. Can we standardize to `outputSchema` + v1 snippets?
Omar: noted. I'll update JS snippet to use `invokeTool`.
Pri: I'll handle the JSON schema; recommend strict canonical example with `additionalProperties: false`.
Nina: good. Keep a one-line migration note: `response_schema -> outputSchema`, `callTool() -> invokeTool()`.
Omar: JS snippet (v1):
```js
const r = await client.invokeTool('summarize',{input:doc,params:{temperature:0}});
console.log(r.output);
```
Pri: schema to paste:
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"},"notes":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["summary"],"additionalProperties":false}
```
Nina: add a tiny parse+validate example and a caching warning linking docs.
Omar: parse example:
```js
try{const p=JSON.parse(r.output);validate(p,schema);}catch(e){/* fallback or rerun with clearer prompt */}
```
Pri: caching note: "Deterministic tool outputs may be stale with prefix KV caching; see https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/caching#prefix-kv"
Nina: created branch `docs/structured-v1-snippets` PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/531
BuildBot: scheduled jobs: docs/link-check and docs/schema-lint on PR #531.
PreviewBot: preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-531/ (48h)
Omar: fixed two TOC links in the branch.
Pri: added a tiny TypeScript mapping note to show why strict schema helps.
Nina: thanks — plan: vet lint, validate schema, merge when green. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
